license.name: Government Open Data License - India
license.platform_owner_statement: Published datasets/resources and metadata on data.gov.in are licensed under the Government Open Data License - India by the respective Ministry/State/Department/Organization.
license.license_scope_interpretation: The OGD platform and OGDL establish a reusable open-data basis for covered non-sensitive data, but OGDL section 6 excludes personal information and other excluded categories. Presence of a field in a downloadable resource does not by itself prove that every field is safely redistributable under OGDL.

remaining_publication_gates: canonical resource identity must be resolved against authoritative resource metadata
public projection must exclude all privacy-risk/person-contact fields
observed non-person fields must be semantically reviewed before curation
geographic identifiers must remain uninterpreted until evidence-backed crosswalk linkage is established
scientific validation and provenance must pass
exact main-head CI must be green
